page_title: LAZ 2-0 CAG | Lazio v Cagliari 03/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+1' 2 - 0 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the top right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Elia Caprile, so the score changes to 2:0.
90+1' Pedro (Lazio) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Lazio.
89' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies well wide of the right post.
88' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
87' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
86' The corner is swung in but Cagliari can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag and Cagliari will take a corner.

85' Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The referee blows his whistle, Cagliari are awarded a corner kick.
84' The substitution is prepared. Pedro (Lazio) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Gustav Isaksen.
84' Here is a change. Boulaye Dia is going off and Maurizio Sarri gives the last tactical orders to Tijjani Noslin (Lazio).
83' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) is quick to pick up the loose pass from Mattia Felici. He tries his luck from mid-range, but it goes well wide of the right post.
82' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
81' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
79' That's the end of the game for Marco Palestra, who is replaced by Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari).
79' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
79' Fabio Pisacane has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) replacing Michael Folorunsho.
78' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The ball goes out of play. Lazio are awarded a corner kick.

76' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom right corner. Ivan Provedel has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
76' The corner from Mattia Felici (Cagliari) is cleared away by the defence.
75' The ball goes out of play. Cagliari are awarded a corner kick. Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Mattia Felici (Cagliari). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
74' A pass into the penalty area from Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) is intercepted by the defence. Cagliari earn a corner.
74' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) is coming onto the pitch as Manuel Lazzari cannot continue after picking up an injury.
72' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
70' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
69' Fabio Pisacane decides to make a substitution. Gennaro Borrelli will be replaced by Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari).
69' Substitution. Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) in, Sebastiano Esposito out.
67' Ivan Provedel displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
65' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
65' 1 - 0 Goal! Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) is teed up on the edge of the box by Matteo Guendouzi, and his howitzer of a shot inside the left post gives the keeper no chance. 1:0.
64' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle as Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
63' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
62' Substitution. Matias Vecino (Lazio) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Toma Basic walks off.
61' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Adam Marusic (Lazio) but poses no threat.
60' The ball is cleared after Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
59' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Luca Sacchi had an easy-decision to make.
59' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
57' Fabio Pisacane has decided to substitute Gianluca Gaetano and he is replaced by Mattia Felici (Cagliari).
56' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
55' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
53' Ivan Provedel makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Yerry Mina (Cagliari) after a cross from the side.

52' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) rifles a low drive from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic reflex save.
51' Toma Basic (Lazio) takes the corner kick, but Elia Caprile reads it well and stops the effort.
51' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Corner kick. Lazio will have an opportunity.
49' Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
48' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) picks up a rebound, moves into space and fires a shot at goal from long range that rises sharply and goes high over the bar.
46' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) was quite harsh and Juan Luca Sacchi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
46' Maurizio Sarri has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Oliver Provstgaard comes on the pitch for Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio).
46' Referee Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.

44' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) bursts into the box for a cross from the set piece and tries to score. The ball flies off his boot towards the middle of the target, but one of the defenders meets it halfway and stops the shot.
43' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) will take the free kick.
42' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Michel Adopo (Cagliari).
40' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) tries to find Adam Marusic, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
39' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
37' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
34' The foul by Boulaye Dia (Lazio) was seen by Juan Luca Sacchi who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

31' Elia Caprile is a nightmare for the offensive players! Adam Marusic (Lazio) meets a cross on the edge of the penalty area, takes a good first touch and fires a rocket of a shot towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper produces a wonderful save.
31' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
30' Golden opportunity! Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass.
28' CHANCE! Mattia Zaccagni finds Toma Basic (Lazio) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just over the bar!
27' The corner kick from Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

26' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger. The ball goes behind for a corner. Lazio will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
26' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee signals a corner kick to Lazio.
25' Toma Basic (Lazio) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
24' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
24' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
22' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
22' Cagliari will take a free kick near the side line.
21' A clumsy foul by Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle.
20' That's a well-taken pass by Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
19' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Elia Caprile, who smothers the ball.
18' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
18' Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
15' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) receives a short pass and produces a low effort from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes a routine save.
14' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball has crossed the sideline. Cagliari are taking a throw-in.
11' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle and it's Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
10' The resulting corner, taken by Toma Basic (Lazio), comes to nothing.
9' Lazio are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes. Lazio will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
9' Toma Basic (Lazio) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
7' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
6' Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul after Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
5' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
3' The corner from Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) is intercepted by the defence.
3' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Cagliari have a corner.
2' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) commits a foul and Juan Luca Sacchi immediately signals a free kick.
1' Adam Marusic (Lazio) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Lazio will have the kick-off.
Juan Luca Sacchi is introduced as the referee for today's match.
